name: Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Phorose)
description: A T-series tactical droid served as the commander of the Separatist Droid Army on the planet Phorose. During the battle of Phorose, he ordered a squad of battle droids to search the underground temple constructed by the Ru for the Jedi Padawans Ahsoka Tano and Barriss Offee.
